svg.title: REMAKE Miryoku — all layers
svg.desc: 36-key REMAKE split keyboard. Each layer is shown in typing orientation with staggered columns and three thumbs per hand. Lower legends on dual-function keys show hold actions; tinted thumbs on sublayers mark the held selector. Down triangles are transparent bindings, and dashes are disabled bindings. Colors use Ef Melissa Light.
svg.metadata: keyboard.toml sha256: a17932a280042fe6106a0ad9eadb727e472afa42ccc42e1146bfefdcefef5a92; palette: Ef Melissa Light 2.2.1, Protesilaos Stavrou; schematic key placement.
svg.text: 36 keys · three thumbs per hand · US symbol legends
Tap: large legend · Hold: colored lower legend · ▽ transparent · — disabled

g.text: Tap for typing. Hold a colored thumb to access its matching layer.

g.title: Nav (3,3): No; held selector from Base
Mouse (3,4): No; held selector from Base
Media (3,2): No; held selector from Base
Num (3,6): No; held selector from Base
Sym (3,5): No; held selector from Base
Fun (3,7): No; held selector from Base

svg.text: Boot: double-tap the same-hand top-row pinkie while holding a layer thumb. Redo uses macro 0.
Num / Sym / Fun: right thumb, left-hand actions. Nav / Mouse / Media: left thumb, right-hand actions.
HELD marks the selector, not a new binding. Small chord labels show modifiers pressed with the key.
Source: keyboard.toml · schematic placement · Ef Melissa Light palette
